headline: Thailand Seeks US Tariff Reduction to 10% Following Trade Deal
summary: Thailand is moving to negotiate a reduction in US Section 301 tariffs down to 10% from 12.5% after concluding key trade terms, matching levels applied to Cambodia, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
why: Tariff parity with Southeast Asian neighbours is critical for Thailand's export-reliant electronics and automotive parts sectors.

impacts.name: SET Index
impacts.why: Potential tariff reductions to 10% would improve Thai manufactured export competitiveness in the US.
